methods.what: Asymptotic (divergent) series for the integral of $e^x/x$, with factorial coefficients
Numerical combination of factorial-type alternating series by differencing
Polar substitution for complex argument and splitting $e^x$ into real and imaginary parts
Approximating the integral by a sum of integrand values with step $\omega$, writing the integrand as $e^{x-n\log x}$
Differentiation of the integral with respect to the parameter $n$, including the variable limit
